utter.lang="en-US";utter.rate=1;

}
function norm(s){
return String(s).toLowerCase()
.replace(/[أإآ]/g,"ا")
.replace(/[ًٌٍَُِّْٰ]/g,"")
.replace(/ة/g,"ه").replace(/ى/g,"ي").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
}
function checkAnswer(item,userAns){
if(!userAns)return false;
const nu=norm(userAns);
if(nu.length<2)return false;
if(item.dir==="ar2en"){
const forms=String(item.en).toLowerCase().split(/[–—\/]/).map(s=>s.replace(/\(.*?\)/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim()).filter(s=>s.length>1);
return forms.some(f=>nu===norm(f));
}
const parts=String(item.ar).split(/[-–—\/·,]+/).map(s=>s.replace(/[()]/g," ").replace(/\s+/g," ").trim()).filter(s=>s.length>1);
return parts.some(p=>{const np=norm(p);if(!np)return false;return nu===np||nu.includes(np)||np.includes(nu);});
}

async function hashPassword(pass,name){
const msg="_k744d3a"+name.trim().toLowerCase()+"::"+pass;
try{
if(window.crypto && crypto.subtle && window.isSecureContext){
const data=new TextEncoder().encode(msg);
const buf=await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256",data);
return "s2:"+Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}
}catch(e){}
let h1=0x811c9dc5,h2=0x01000193;
for(let i=0;i<msg.length;i++){
const c=msg.charCodeAt(i);
h1=Math.imul(h1^c,0x01000193)>>>0;
h2=Math.imul(h2+c,0x85ebca6b)>>>0;
}
return "f1:"+h1.toString(16).padStart(8,"0")+h2.toString(16).padStart(8,"0");
}

function tsCS(s){let x=0;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++)x=(x+s.charCodeAt(i))%36;return x.toString(36).toUpperCase();}
function tsEnc(p){let bits="";for(let i=0;i<p.length;i++){const c=p.charCodeAt(i);if(c<33||c>126)return null;bits+=c.toString(2).padStart(7,"0");}while(bits.length%5)bits+="0";let out="";for(let i=0;i<bits.length;i+=5){out+=TS_A[parseInt(bits.substr(i,5),2)];}return out;}
function tsDec(e){let bits="";for(const ch of e){const v=TS_A.indexOf(ch);if(v<0)return null;bits+=v.toString(2).padStart(5,"0");}let out="";for(let i=0;i+7<=bits.length;i+=7){out+=String.fromCharCode(parseInt(bits.substr(i,7),2));}return out;}
const TS_A="ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
function tsPack(mem){let bits="";mem.forEach(l=>l.forEach(v=>bits+=v?"1":"0"));while(bits.length%5)bits+="0";let out="";for(let i=0;i<bits.length;i+=5){out+=TS_A[parseInt(bits.substr(i,5),2)];}return out;}
function tsUnpack(str){let bits="";for(const ch of str){const v=TS_A.indexOf(ch);if(v<0)return null;bits+=v.toString(2).padStart(5,"0");}const sizes=LEVELS.map(l=>l.words.length);let pos=0;const mem=[];for(const sz of sizes){const arr=[];for(let i=0;i<sz;i++){arr.push(bits[pos]==="1");pos++;}mem.push(arr);}return mem;}
function makeTransferCode(){
let nm="",ps="";
try{const raw=LocalDB.get("_rm7q2x9");if(!raw)return null;const d=JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(raw))));nm=d.n;ps=d.p;}catch(e){return null;}
if(!nm||!ps)return null;
if(nm.length>32||nm.length<2)return "LONG";
const enc=tsEnc(ps);
if(enc===null)return "AR";
const data=JSON.parse(LocalDB.get(userKey(nm))||"{}");
let mem=null;
try{const pr=JSON.parse(LocalDB.get(progressKey(nm))||"null");if(pr&&pr.memorized)mem=pr.memorized;}catch(e){}
const prog=mem?tsPack(mem):"";
const rc=(data.rc&&data.rc.length===6)?data.rc:"------";
const el=enc.length;
const encLen2=TS_A[Math.floor(el/32)]+TS_A[el%32];
const head=TS_A[nm.length]+nm;
const rest=(encLen2+enc+rc+prog).toUpperCase();
const fin=(head+rest).toUpperCase();
return head+rest+tsCS(fin);
}
document.getElementById("codeBtn").onclick=async()=>{
const errEl=document.getElementById("codeErr");
errEl.textContent="";
const code=document.getElementById("codeInput").value.trim().replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g,"");
const c0=code.toUpperCase();
if(c0.length<12){errEl.textContent="الكود غلط — قصير أوي";return;}
const nl=TS_A.indexOf(c0[0]);
if(nl<2||nl>32||code.length<1+nl+3){errEl.textContent="الكود غلط";return;}
const nmRaw=code.slice(1,1+nl);
const lname=nmRaw.toLowerCase();
let pos=1+nl;
const e1=TS_A.indexOf(c0[pos]),e2=TS_A.indexOf(c0[pos+1]);
if(e1<0||e2<0){errEl.textContent="الكود غلط";return;}
const el=e1*32+e2; pos+=2;
if(c0.length<pos+el+6+1){errEl.textContent="الكود ناقص — انسخه كامل";return;}
const enc=c0.substr(pos,el); pos+=el;
const rc=c0.substr(pos,6); pos+=6;
const prog=c0.slice(pos,-1);
const cs=c0.slice(-1);
if(tsCS(c0.slice(0,-1))!==cs){errEl.textContent="الكود غلط أو اتنقل غلط — انسخه تاني";return;}
const pass=tsDec(enc);
if(pass===null){errEl.textContent="الكود فيه حروف غلط";return;}
const mem=prog?tsUnpack(prog):null;
const pw=await hashPassword(pass,lname);
LocalDB.set(userKey(lname),JSON.stringify({pw:pw,rc:rc,ag:"",dn:nmRaw}));
if(mem){LocalDB.set(progressKey(lname),JSON.stringify({memorized:mem,quizHistory:[]}));}
saveRemember(lname,pass);
LocalDB.set(SESSION_KEY,lname);
currentUsername=nmRaw;
await enterApp();
};

wiz.data[st.k]=v;
wiz.step++;
renderWiz();
})();
return;
}
if(st.k==="pw"){if(v.length<4){err.textContent="الباسورد لازم 4 حروف على الأقل";return;}}
if(st.k==="pw2"){if(v!==wiz.data.pw){err.textContent="الباسوردين مش متطابقين";inp.classList.add("_x493d44");setTimeout(()=>inp.classList.remove("_x493d44"),400);return;}}

function memPack(m){return (m||[]).map(l=>l.map(v=>v?"1":"0").join(""));}
function memUnpack(a){return (a||[]).map(s=>String(s).split("").map(c=>c==="1"));}
function wordsPack(ws){return (ws||[]).map(w=>({e:w[0],a:w[1],d:w[2]||""}));}
function wordsUnpack(ws){return (ws||[]).map(o=>o.d?[o.e,o.a,o.d]:[o.e,o.a]);}
let _fs=null,_cloudOK=false,_cloudTried=false;
function setCloudDot(st,err){
const d=document.getElementById("cloudDot");if(!d)return;
if(st==="on"){d.style.background="var(--good)";d.title="متصل بالسحابة \u2601\uFE0F";}
else if(st==="off"){d.style.background="var(--gentle)";d.title="غير متصل: "+(err||"مفيش نت");}
else{d.style.background="var(--accent)";d.title="جاري الاتصال...";}
d.onclick=()=>{showToast(st==="on"?"\u2601\uFE0F متصل بالسحابة":st==="off"?("غير متصل \u2014 "+(err||window._lastCloudErr||"شيك على النت")):"جاري الاتصال...");};
}
async function cloudInit(){if(_cloudTried)return _cloudOK;_cloudTried=true;try{if(typeof firebase==="undefined"){window._cloudErr="firebase مش متحملة (شيك على النت)";setCloudDot("off",window._cloudErr);return false;}firebase.initializeApp(FB_CFG);_fs=firebase.firestore();await _fs.enableNetwork&&_fs.enableNetwork();_cloudOK=true;setCloudDot("on");
try{await _fs.collection("ping").doc("t").set({t:Date.now()});const _p=await _fs.collection("ping").doc("t").get();if(!_p.exists)throw new Error("write ok / read failed");}
catch(e){window._lastCloudErr="فحص القواعد: "+e.message;setCloudDot("off",window._lastCloudErr);}
}catch(e){_cloudOK=false;window._cloudErr=e.message;setCloudDot("off",e.message);}return _cloudOK;}
window._lastCloudErr="";
async function cloudGet(c,id){try{if(!await cloudInit())return null;const d=await _fs.collection(c).doc(id).get();return d.exists?d.data():null;}catch(e){window._lastCloudErr="قراءة "+c+": "+e.message;setCloudDot("off",window._lastCloudErr);return null;}}
async function cloudList(c){try{if(!await cloudInit())return[];const s=await _fs.collection(c).get();const out=[];s.forEach(d=>out.push({id:d.id,data:d.data()}));return out;}catch(e){return[];}}
async function cloudSet(c,id,data){try{if(!await cloudInit())return false;data.updatedAt=Date.now();await _fs.collection(c).doc(id).set(data);return true;}catch(e){window._lastCloudErr="كتابة "+c+": "+e.message;setCloudDot("off",window._lastCloudErr);return false;}}
async function cloudPullAll(){
try{
const un=(currentUsername||"").trim().toLowerCase();
if(un){
const ud=await cloudGet("users",un);
if(ud&&!LocalDB.get(userKey(currentUsername))){try{LocalDB.set(userKey(currentUsername),JSON.stringify(ud));}catch(e){}}
const pd=await cloudGet("progress",un);
if(pd){const lpRaw=LocalDB.get(progressKey(currentUsername));let lpTs=0;try{const lp=JSON.parse(lpRaw||"null");lpTs=(lp&&lp.updatedAt)||0;}catch(e){}
if(!lpRaw||(pd.updatedAt||0)>lpTs){try{LocalDB.set(progressKey(currentUsername),JSON.stringify({memorized:memUnpack(pd.memorized),quizHistory:pd.quizHistory||[],updatedAt:pd.updatedAt||Date.now()}));}catch(e){}}}
}
try{const mm=await cloudGet("msgs",un);if(mm&&mm.text)window._pendingMsg=mm.text;
try{_q024x();}catch(e){}}catch(e){}
const cd=await cloudGet("content","main");
if(cd){
if(cd.announcement&&cd.announcement.msg){try{LocalDB.set("nutq-announce",JSON.stringify(cd.announcement));}catch(e){}}
else if(cd.announcement&&!cd.announcement.msg){try{LocalDB.remove("nutq-announce");}catch(e){}}
if(cd.levels){
for(let i=LEVELS.length-1;i>=0;i--){if(LEVELS[i]._custom)LEVELS.splice(i,1);}
while(state.memorized.length>LEVELS.length)state.memorized.pop();
(cd.levels||[]).forEach(l=>{const wl=wordsUnpack(l.words);const nl={name:l.name,desc:l.desc,words:wl,_custom:true};LEVELS.push(nl);state.memorized.push(wl.map(()=>false));});
try{LocalDB.set("nutq-custom:"+OWNER_NAME.toLowerCase(),JSON.stringify({levels:cd.levels}));}catch(e){}
}
if(cd.hidden){(cd.hidden.levels||[]).forEach(x=>HIDDEN.levels.add(x));(cd.hidden.study||[]).forEach(x=>HIDDEN.study.add(x));saveHidden();}
}
}catch(e){}
}

async function renderStudents(){
const list=document.getElementById("stuList");
list.innerHTML='<div class="search-empty">جاري جلب بيانات الطلاب...</div>';
const us=await cloudList("users");
let dirOnly=[];
try{
const uids={};(us||[]).forEach(u=>uids[u.id]=1);
const d=await cloudList("students");
dirOnly=(d||[]).filter(x=>!uids[x.id]);
}catch(e){}
if(!us.length&&!dirOnly.length){list.innerHTML='<div class="search-empty">مفيش طلاب مسجلين في السحابة لسه</div>';return;}
const progMap={};
await Promise.all(us.map(async u=>{progMap[u.id]=await cloudGet("progress",u.id);}));
const msgMap={};
(await cloudList("msgs")).forEach(m=>{msgMap[m.id]=m.data;});
const all=us.map(u=>({id:u.id,data:u.data||{}})).concat(dirOnly.map(x=>({id:x.id,data:{dn:(x.data||{}).dn,ph:(x.data||{}).ph,createdAt:0,lastSeen:0,_dir:1}})));
list.innerHTML="";
all.sort((x,y)=>String((x.data||{}).dn||"").localeCompare(String((y.data||{}).dn||""),"ar"));
all.forEach(u=>{
const d=u.data||{};
let memo=0,total=0,curLvl="لسه مبدأ";
const p=progMap[u.id];
if(p&&p.memorized){
const bits=memUnpack(p.memorized);
for(let li=0;li<LEVELS.length&&li<bits.length;li++){
if(isHiddenLevel(LEVELS[li].name))continue;
const st=bits[li];total+=st.length;
const ones=st.filter(Boolean).length;memo+=ones;
if(ones<st.length&&curLvl==="لسه مبدأ")curLvl=LEVELS[li].name.split("·").slice(1).join("·").trim();
}
}
const adm=window._ADMINS[u.id];
const hasMsg=msgMap[u.id]&&msgMap[u.id].text;
const el=document.createElement("div");
el.className="study-card";
el.innerHTML=
'<div class="study-top"><span class="study-t">'+(adm?('<span class="si-badge" style="background:rgba(245,179,1,.15);color:#c78a00;">👑 '+(adm.role||"مالك")+"</span> "):"")+(d.dn||u.id)+(d._dir?' <span class="si-badge" style="background:rgba(74,158,255,.12);color:#4a9eff;">من قائمة المالك</span>':"")+'</span><span class="si-badge">'+(d.ph||"—")+'</span></div>'+
'<div class="rvlab" style="margin-top:6px;">انضم: '+(d._dir?"—":daysAgo(d.createdAt))+' · آخر دخول: '+(d._dir?"—":daysAgo(d.lastSeen))+'</div>'+
'<div class="rvlab">'+(d._dir?"بدون حساب على المنصة":"التقدم: "+memo+" / "+total+" كلمة محفوظة · واصل: "+curLvl)+'</div>'+
(hasMsg?'<div class="rvans mine ok" style="margin-top:8px;text-decoration:none;">📩 '+(msgMap[u.id].text)+'</div>':'')+
(_q025x()&&!_q047x(u.id)?'<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;">'+(adm
?'<button class="memo-btn" data-demote2="'+u.id+'" style="flex:1;">↩ إلغاء صفة المالك</button><button class="memo-btn" data-role2="'+u.id+'" style="flex:1;">✏️ الوظيفة</button>'

document.getElementById("owFile").onchange=async(e)=>{

try{
if(typeof Tesseract==="undefined"){showToast("\u0627\u0633\u062A\u0646\u0627 \u0627\u0644\u0645\u0643\u062A\u0628\u0629 \u0628\u062A\u062A\u062D\u0645\u0644... \u062C\u0631\u0628 \u062A\u0627\u0646\u064A");return;}

if(lines.length){document.getElementById("owWords").value=lines.join("\n");showToast("\u0627\u062A\u0642\u0631\u0623 "+lines.length+" \u0643\u0644\u0645\u0629 \u2014 \u0631\u0627\u062C\u0639\u0647\u0627 \u0648\u0639\u062F\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u063A\u0644\u0637 \u0642\u0628\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u0625\u0636\u0627\u0641\u0629 \u2713");}
else{showToast("\u0645\u0641\u064A\u0634 \u0643\u0644\u0645\u0627\u062A \u0648\u0627\u0636\u062D\u0629 \u2014 \u062C\u0631\u0628 \u0635\u0648\u0631\u0629 \u0623\u0642\u0631\u0628 \u0648\u0623\u0648\u0636\u062D");}
}catch(err){showToast("\u062D\u0635\u0644 \u062E\u0637\u0623 \u0641\u064A \u0627\u0644\u0642\u0631\u0627\u0621\u0629");}
e.target.value="";
};
function parseOcrLine(line){
const m=line.match(/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z'\u2019()\- ]{1,30})\s+([\u0600-\u06FF][\u0600-\u06FF\s()\u060C\/\-]{1,60})/);
if(!m)return null;
const en=m[1].trim().replace(/\s{2,}/g," "),ar=m[2].trim().replace(/\s{2,}/g," ");
if(en.length<2||ar.length<2)return null;
return en+" = "+ar;
}

t.style.display="block";

}

function groupUnits(){
const units=[];
LEVELS.forEach((lvl,i)=>{
if(isHiddenLevel(lvl.name))return;
const unitName=lvl.name.split("·")[0].trim();
if(!units.length||units[units.length-1].name!==unitName)units.push({name:unitName,levels:[]});
units[units.length-1].levels.push(i);
});
return units;
}

function doSearch(q){
const panel=document.getElementById("_x167923");
const nq=norm(q);
if(nq.length<2){panel.classList.remove("_x88d9d2");panel.innerHTML="";return;}
const res=[];
LEVELS.forEach((lvl,li)=>{
if(isHiddenLevel(lvl.name))return;
lvl.words.forEach(w=>{
if(norm(w[0]).includes(nq)||norm(w[1]).includes(nq)||(w[2]&&norm(w[2]).includes(nq)))
res.push({k:"w",en:w[0],ar:w[1],lvl:lvl.name});
});
});
STUDY.forEach(g=>{
g.items.forEach(it=>{
if(norm(it.t).includes(nq)||norm(it.ar).includes(nq)||(it.def&&norm(it.def).includes(nq))||(it.ex&&norm(it.ex).includes(nq)))
res.push({k:"s",t:it.t,ar:it.ar,sec:g.sec});
});
});
panel.innerHTML="";
if(res.length===0){
panel.innerHTML='<div class="_xc5a3a1">مفيش نتائج مطابقة لـ "'+q+'" 🤔</div>';
panel.classList.add("_x88d9d2");
return;
}

const el=document.createElement("div");
el.className="_x9d50cf";
if(r.k==="w"){
el.innerHTML=`<div class="_xb42772"><span class="_x3ad433 _x4789f9">${r.en}</span><div class="_xeb8a73">${r.ar}</div></div><span class="_x83ac92">${r.lvl}</span><div class="_x14f7b2 _x309b00" title="استمع">🔊</div>`;
el.querySelector("._x14f7b2").onclick=()=>speak(r.en);
}else{
el.innerHTML=`<div class="_xb42772"><span class="_x3ad433 _x4789f9">${r.t}</span><div class="_xeb8a73">${r.ar}</div></div><span class="_x83ac92">${r.sec}</span><div class="_x14f7b2 _x309b00" title="استمع">🔊</div>`;
el.querySelector("._x14f7b2").onclick=()=>speak(r.t);
}
panel.appendChild(el);
});
if(res.length>40){
const more=document.createElement("div");
more.className="_xc5a3a1";
more.textContent="... و "+(res.length-40)+" نتيجة تانية — اكتب كلمة أدق";
panel.appendChild(more);
}
panel.classList.add("_x88d9d2");
}

function finishQuiz(){
const q=state.quiz;
recordCurrent();
const total=q.questions.length;
const results=q.questions.map((item,i)=>{
const a=q.answers[i];
return {en:item.en,ar:item.ar,dir:item.dir,userAns:a?a.userAns:"",isCorrect:!!(a&&a.isCorrect),tried:!!a};
});
const correct=results.filter(r=>r.isCorrect).length;
const pct=Math.round(correct/total*100);
state.quizHistory.push({levelIndex:q.levelIndex,pct});
saveProgress();
document.getElementById("_x300964").style.setProperty("--pct",pct);
document.getElementById("_xe46c5a").textContent=pct;
document.getElementById("_x58ee51").textContent=correct+" صحيحة · "+(total-correct)+" غلط · من أصل "+total;
let msg="";
if(pct>=90)msg="أسطوري! أداء رهيب جداً";
else if(pct>=70)msg="شغل حلو أوي، كمّل كده";
else if(pct>=50)msg="بداية كويسة، راجع الغلطات";
else msg="مفيش مشكلة — اسحب الكروت وراجع المعنى الكامل لكل كلمة";
document.getElementById("_xe7e614").textContent=msg;
if(pct>=70)burstConfetti(document.getElementById("_x23efa7"),12);
if(q.levelIndex+1<LEVELS.length){
const wasLocked=!state.quizHistory.slice(0,-1).some(h=>h.levelIndex===q.levelIndex);
if(wasLocked)setTimeout(()=>showToast("فتحت المستوى اللي بعده! 🎉"),400);
}

let spState={order:[],index:0,current:null,placed:[]};
function startSentPractice(){
spState.order=shuffle(SENT_EXERCISES.map((_,i)=>i));
spState.index=0;
loadSentExercise();
}
function loadSentExercise(){
const ex=SENT_EXERCISES[spState.order[spState.index]];
spState.current=ex;
spState.placed=[];
document.getElementById("_xb30eb6").textContent=(spState.index+1)+" / "+SENT_EXERCISES.length;
document.getElementById("_xeb2711").style.width=Math.round(spState.index/SENT_EXERCISES.length*100)+"%";

renderSentBank();
renderSentAnswer();
}
function renderSentBank(){
const bank=document.getElementById("_x70393c");
bank.innerHTML="";
const shuffled=spState.current.tokens.map((t,i)=>({t,i})).sort(()=>Math.random()-0.5);
shuffled.forEach(item=>{
const chip=document.createElement("div");
chip.className="_x3f3e5d _x4789f9"+(spState.placed.includes(item.i)?" _x62207e":"");
chip.textContent=item.t;
chip.onclick=()=>{
if(spState.placed.includes(item.i))return;
spState.placed.push(item.i);
renderSentBank();
renderSentAnswer();
};
bank.appendChild(chip);
});
}
function renderSentAnswer(){
const box=document.getElementById("_x3d075e");
box.innerHTML="";
spState.placed.forEach((tokenIdx,pos)=>{
const chip=document.createElement("div");
chip.className="_x3f3e5d _xd94a14 _x4789f9";
chip.textContent=spState.current.tokens[tokenIdx];
chip.onclick=()=>{
spState.placed.splice(pos,1);
renderSentBank();
renderSentAnswer();
};
box.appendChild(chip);
});
const btn=document.getElementById("_xe051d5");
if(btn.textContent==="تحقق"){
btn.disabled=spState.placed.length!==spState.current.tokens.length;
}
}
document.getElementById("_x47c167").onclick=()=>{
if(document.getElementById("_xe051d5").textContent!=="تحقق")return;
spState.placed=[];
renderSentBank();
renderSentAnswer();
};
function checkSentAnswer(){
const ex=spState.current;
if(spState.placed.length!==ex.tokens.length)return;
const userSentence=spState.placed.map(i=>ex.tokens[i]).join(" ");
const correctSentence=ex.tokens.join(" ");
const fb=document.getElementById("_x63b989");
const isLast=spState.index+1>=SENT_EXERCISES.length;
if(userSentence===correctSentence){
fb.textContent=pickRandom(CORRECT_MSGS);
fb.className="_xb26737 _x4e365a";
}else{
fb.innerHTML=pickRandom(TRY_MSGS)+' <span class="_x4789f9" style="color:var(--text);font-weight:700;">'+correctSentence+'</span>';
fb.className="_xb26737 _x8fb2d9";
}
const btn=document.getElementById("_xe051d5");
btn.disabled=false;
btn.textContent=isLast?"من الأول":"التالي";
btn.onclick=()=>{
if(isLast){startSentPractice();}
else{spState.index++;loadSentExercise();}
};
}

}

const qs=[];const qopts=[];
(exData.qs||[]).forEach(line=>{
const p=line.split("|||").map(s=>s.trim());
if(p.length>=5&&p[0]&&p[1]){qs.push([p[0],p[1]]);const o=p.slice(1,5).filter(Boolean);while(o.length<4)o.push("—");qopts.push(_q003x(o));}
else if(p.length>=2&&p[0]&&p[1]){qs.push([p[0],p[1]]);qopts.push(null);}
});
if(!qs.length){showToast("الامتحان ده لسه مفيهوش أسئلة");renderUnit(state.currentUnit);showScreen("_s22a890");return;}
EXAM_ATTEMPT={rid:rid,exId:exId,qs:qs,opts:qopts,answers:qs.map(()=>""),idx:0,status:"on",off:srv-Date.now(),deadline:Date.now()+(exData.dur||10)*60000,graceMs:(exData.grace||5)*60000,lastSync:Date.now()};

}

function _q008x(){

const left=a.deadline-now;
const tw=document.getElementById("examTimerWrap");
if(tw.style.display==="none")tw.style.display="block";
const tt=document.getElementById("examTimerText");
if(left>0){
document.getElementById("examGraceBanner").style.display="none";
tt.textContent=_q007x(left);tt.style.color="var(--good)";
document.getElementById("examTimerLabel").textContent="⏱ الوقت المتبقي";
}else{
const gleft=a.deadline+a.graceMs-now;
document.getElementById("examGraceBanner").style.display="block";
tt.textContent=_q007x(gleft);tt.style.color="var(--gentle)";

}
_q011x();
}

function _q013x(a){
let c=0;const wrong=[];
a.qs.forEach((q,i)=>{
const given=(a.answers[i]||"").trim();
if(given===q[1])c++;
else wrong.push({q:q[0],right:q[1],given:given||"— بدون إجابة —"});
});
return {score:c,total:a.qs.length,wrong:wrong};
}

async function _q030x(id){

_q041x(document.getElementById("profMonth"));

}
async function _q031x(){
const month=document.getElementById("profMonth").value;
const box=document.getElementById("profLessons");box.innerHTML="<p style='color:var(--muted);text-align:center;'>⏳...</p>";
let L={sess:[]};
try{if(await cloudInit()){const m=await cloudGet("monitor",PROF+"__"+month);if(m&&m.sess)L={sess:m.sess};}}catch(e){}
window._profL=L;
if(!Array.isArray(L.sess))L.sess=[];
const info=window._profInfo||{};
const sessions=await _q023x(month,info.grp||"");
box.innerHTML="";
if(!sessions.length){box.innerHTML="<p style='color:var(--muted);text-align:center;'>⚠️ مفيش مواعيد حصص للشهر ده — حددها من قسم «🗓 مواعيد الحصص»</p>";return;}
sessions.forEach((ss,i)=>{
const cur=L.sess[i]||{a:0,h:0,e:0,l:0,at:""};L.sess[i]=cur;
if(cur.ext===undefined)cur.ext=cur.e||0;
if(cur.exn===undefined)cur.exn="";
if(cur.exg===undefined)cur.exg="";
const row=document.createElement("div");row.className="study-card";row.style.marginBottom="10px";
row.innerHTML='<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:8px;">📚 الحصة '+(i+1)+' — '+ss.d+(ss.dt?' <span style="color:var(--good);font-size:11px;">📅 '+_q043x(ss.dt)+'</span>':'')+(ss.t?' <span style="color:var(--accent);font-size:12px;">🕐 '+ss.t+'</span>':'')+'</div>'
+'<div class="mrow">'
+'<div class="seg" data-k="a"><button data-v="0">غياب ✗</button><button data-v="1">حضور ✔</button></div>'
+'<div class="seg" data-k="h"><button data-v="0">مفيش واجب</button><button data-v="1">الواجب ✔</button></div>'
+'<div class="seg" data-k="ext"><button data-v="1">💻 أونلاين</button><button data-v="2">🏫 سنتر</button></div>'
+'</div>'
+'<div data-k="exsw" style="display:none;margin-top:8px;"><select class="_xaa9c45" data-k="exn" style="margin:0;font-size:12px;padding:9px;text-align:center;"></select></div>'
+'<div data-k="exgw" style="display:none;margin-top:8px;align-items:center;gap:6px;"><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);flex:none;">الدرجة:</span><input class="_xaa9c45" data-k="exg" placeholder="مثال: 18/20" style="flex:1;margin:0;padding:9px;text-align:center;direction:ltr;font-size:12px;"></div>'
+'<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:8px;"><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);">المستوى:</span><span class="stars" data-k="l">'+[1,2,3,4,5].map(n=>'<span data-n="'+n+'">★</span>').join("")+'</span></div>'
+'<div class="atline" style="display:'+(cur.at?"block":"none")+';font-size:11px;color:var(--good);margin-top:6px;">🕐 '+cur.at+'</div>';
row.querySelectorAll(".seg").forEach(sg=>{
const k=sg.dataset.k;
const paint=()=>{sg.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("on",parseInt(b.dataset.v)===cur[k]));};
paint();
sg.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
const v=parseInt(b.dataset.v);cur[k]=v;
if(k==="a"){cur.at=v===1?(ss.dt?_q043x(ss.dt):_q037x()):"";const at=row.querySelector(".atline");at.style.display=cur.at?"block":"none";at.textContent="🕐 "+cur.at;}
paint();
});
});
const stars=row.querySelector(".stars");
const paintStars=()=>{stars.querySelectorAll("span").forEach(sp=>sp.classList.toggle("f",parseInt(sp.dataset.n)<=cur.l));};
paintStars();
stars.querySelectorAll("span").forEach(sp=>sp.onclick=()=>{const n=parseInt(sp.dataset.n);cur.l=(cur.l===n)?0:n;paintStars();});
const exSel=row.querySelector("[data-k=exn]");
(async()=>{
let list=null;
try{if(await cloudInit())list=await cloudList("exams");}catch(e){}
if(!list||!list.length){try{const c=JSON.parse(LocalDB.get("nutq-exams")||"[]");if(c&&c.length)list=c;}catch(e){}}
let opts='<option value="">\uD83D\uDCDD \u0627\u062E\u062A\u0631 \u0627\u0644\u0627\u0645\u062A\u062D\u0627\u0646 \u0627\u0644\u0623\u0648\u0646\u0644\u0627\u064A\u0646:</option>';
if(list&&list.length){
list.filter(e=>e.data&&e.data.active!==false&&e.id!=="_srv").forEach(e=>{opts+='<option value="'+e.id+'"'+(cur.exn===e.id?" selected":"")+'>'+(e.data.title||"\u0627\u0645\u062A\u062D\u0627\u0646")+"</option>";});
exSel.innerHTML=opts;
}else{
exSel.innerHTML='<option value="">\u26A0\uFE0F \u0645\u0641\u064A\u0634 \u0627\u0645\u062A\u062D\u0627\u0646 \u0623\u0648\u0646\u0644\u0627\u064A\u0646 \u0645\u0646\u0634\u0648\u0631</option>';
}
})();
const extSeg=row.querySelector(".seg[data-k=ext]");
const exgW=row.querySelector("[data-k=exgw]");
const exgInp=row.querySelector("[data-k=exg]");
const exSelW=row.querySelector("[data-k=exsw]");
const paintExam=()=>{
const isOn=cur.ext===1;
exSelW.style.display=isOn?"block":"none";
exgW.style.display=(isOn&&cur.exn)||cur.ext===2?"flex":"none";
if(!isOn)cur.exn="";
exgInp.value=cur.exg||"";
};
exSel.onchange=async()=>{
cur.exn=exSel.value;
paintExam();
if(cur.ext===1&&cur.exn){
try{
const res=await cloudGet("examResults",cur.exn+"__"+PROF);
if(res&&res.status==="done"){cur.exg=res.score+"/"+res.total;exgInp.value=cur.exg;}
}catch(e){}
}
};
exgInp.oninput=()=>{cur.exg=exgInp.value;};
extSeg.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b=>b.addEventListener("click",paintExam));
paintExam();
box.appendChild(row);
});
}

async function _q032x(id){
const box=document.getElementById("_q032x");box.innerHTML="<p style='color:var(--muted);text-align:center;'>⏳...</p>";
let res=[];let exams=[];
try{if(await cloudInit()){res=await cloudList("examResults");exams=await cloudList("exams");}}catch(e){}
const mine=(res||[]).filter(r=>r.id.indexOf("__"+id)>0);
const titles={};(exams||[]).forEach(e=>{titles[e.id]=e.data.title||"امتحان";});
box.innerHTML="";
if(!mine.length){box.innerHTML="<p style='color:var(--muted);text-align:center;'>الطالب ده لسه محلش امتحانات</p>";return;}
mine.forEach(r=>{
const d=r.data;
const el=document.createElement("div");el.className="study-card";el.style.marginBottom="8px";
el.innerHTML='<div class="study-top"><span class="study-t">📝 '+(titles[d.exId]||"امتحان")+'</span><span class="si-badge" style="color:'+(d.status==="done"?"var(--good)":"var(--gentle)")+';">'+(d.status==="done"?(d.score+" / "+d.total):"اتلغى ⛔")+"</span></div>";
box.appendChild(el);
});
}
async function _q033x(stu,month){
if(!stu){showToast("اختار الطالب");return;}
let L={sess:[]},info={};
try{if(await cloudInit()){const m=await cloudGet("monitor",stu+"__"+month);if(m&&m.sess)L={sess:m.sess};info=(await cloudGet("students",stu))||{};}}catch(e){}
const sessions=await _q023x(month,info.grp||"");
const ss=Array.isArray(L.sess)?L.sess:[];
const n=sessions.length;
const g=i=>(ss[i]||{a:0,h:0,e:0,l:0,at:""});
const gExt=i=>(g(i).ext||g(i).e||0);
const cnt=k=>sessions.filter((_,i)=>g(i)[k]).length;
const cntEx=()=>sessions.filter((_,i)=>gExt(i)>0).length;
const lv=sessions.map((_,i)=>g(i).l).filter(x=>x>0);
const avg=lv.length?(lv.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/lv.length).toFixed(1):"—";
let examTitles={};
try{if(await cloudInit()){const el=await cloudList("exams");(el||[]).forEach(e=>{examTitles[e.id]=e.data.title||"امتحان";});}}catch(e){}
const rows=sessions.map((se,i)=>{
const v=g(i);
return '<tr><td style="text-align:right;padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #ddd;font-size:12px;background:'+(i%2?"#fff":"#fafafa")+';"><b>حصة '+(i+1)+'</b> — '+se.d+(se.dt?'<br><span style="font-size:10px;color:#1a7f37;font-weight:bold;">📅 '+_q043x(se.dt)+'</span>':'')+(se.t?'<br><span style="font-size:10px;color:#777;">🕐 '+se.t+'</span>':'')+'</td>'
+'<td style="text-align:center;padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #ddd;font-size:11px;background:'+(v.a?"#e8f7ee":"#fdeaea")+';color:'+(v.a?"#1a7f37":"#c0392b")+';font-weight:bold;">'+(v.a?("✔ حضور<br><span style='font-size:10px;color:#555;'>"+(v.at||"")+"</span>"):"✘ غياب")+'</td>'
+'<td style="text-align:center;padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #ddd;font-size:12px;">'+(v.h?"✔ حلّه":"✘ لم يحل")+'</td>'
+'<td style="text-align:center;padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #ddd;font-size:11px;">'+(v.exn?_q039x(v.ext||v.e||0):'—')+(v.exn&&examTitles[v.exn]?'<br><span style="font-size:10px;color:#1d5fbf;font-weight:bold;">📝 '+examTitles[v.exn]+'</span>':'')+(v.exg?'<br><span style="font-size:10px;color:#1a7f37;font-weight:bold;">الدرجة: '+v.exg+'</span>':'')+'</td>'
+'<td style="text-align:center;padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #ddd;font-size:11px;color:#c78a00;">'+_q038x(v.l||0)+'</td></tr>';
}).join("");
const tot='<tr style="font-weight:bold;background:#f3dede;color:#7a1010;"><td style="text-align:right;padding:7px;border:1px solid #ddd;">الإجمالي</td><td style="text-align:center;padding:7px;border:1px solid #ddd;">'+cnt("a")+'/'+n+'</td><td style="text-align:center;padding:7px;border:1px solid #ddd;">'+cnt("h")+'/'+n+'</td><td style="text-align:center;padding:7px;border:1px solid #ddd;">'+cnt("e")+'/'+n+'<br><span style="font-size:10px;color:#555;">💻'+sessions.filter((_,i)=>gExt(i)===1).length+' · 🏫'+sessions.filter((_,i)=>gExt(i)===2).length+'</span></td><td style="text-align:center;padding:7px;border:1px solid #ddd;">'+avg+'</td></tr>';
let exRows="",exCnt=0;
try{
if(await cloudInit()){
const er=await cloudList("examResults");
const ex=await cloudList("exams");
const titles={};(ex||[]).forEach(e=>{titles[e.id]=e.data.title||"امتحان";});
const mine=(er||[]).filter(r=>(r.id.indexOf("__"+stu)>0||(r.data&&r.data.student&&String(r.data.student).trim().toLowerCase()===stu))&&r.data.status==="done");
exCnt=mine.length;
exRows=mine.map(r=>{
const d=r.data;
const pc=d.pct||Math.round(d.score/d.total*100);
return '<tr><td style="text-align:right;padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #ddd;font-size:12px;">📝 '+(titles[d.exId]||"امتحان")+'</td><td style="text-align:center;padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #ddd;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold;color:#1a7f37;">'+d.score+' / '+d.total+'</td><td style="text-align:center;padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #ddd;font-size:12px;font-weight:bold;">'+pc+'%</td></tr>';
}).join("");
}
}catch(e){}
const exHtml=exCnt
?('<div style="margin-top:14px;"><div style="background:#f3dede;color:#7a1010;font-weight:bold;font-size:13px;padding:9px 6px;border:1px solid #999;border-bottom:none;">📝 درجات الامتحانات</div><table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;"><tr style="background:#fafafa;"><th style="padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #999;font-size:12px;">الامتحان</th><th style="padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #999;font-size:12px;">الدرجة</th><th style="padding:7px 6px;border:1px solid #999;font-size:12px;">النسبة</th></tr>'+exRows+'</table></div>')
:('<div style="margin-top:14px;font-size:12px;color:#777;border:1px dashed #bbb;padding:9px;text-align:center;">📝 لم يمتحن في هذا الشهر</div>');
const pa=document.getElementById("printArea");
pa.innerHTML='<div style="font-family:Cairo,sans-serif;color:#222;direction:rtl;padding:0;background:#fff;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact;">'
+'<div style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b91c1c,#7a1010);color:#fff;padding:18px 16px;text-align:center;">'
+'<div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:800;">📝 منصة Nutq لتعليم الإنجليزية</div>'
+'<div style="font-size:14px;opacity:.9;margin-top:2px;">تقرير المتابعة الشهرية</div>'+'<div style="display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);padding:5px 22px;border-radius:22px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;">✨ Miss Rana Shaheen</div></div>'
+'<div style="padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-top:none;">'
+'<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:12px;"><tr>'
+'<td style="padding:5px;"><b>الشهر:</b> '+_q042x(month)+'</td><td style="padding:5px;"><b>تاريخ الإصدار:</b> '+_q037x()+'</td></tr><tr>'
+'<td style="padding:5px;"><b>الطالب:</b> '+(info.dn||stu)+(info.num?" (#"+info.num+")":"")+'</td><td style="padding:5px;"><b>النوع:</b> '+(info.t||"—")+(info.grp?" — مجموعة "+info.grp:"")+'</td></tr><tr>'
+'<td style="padding:5px;" colspan="2"><b>ولي الأمر:</b> '+(info.wa||"—")+'</td></tr></table>'
+'<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px;text-align:center;">'
+'<div style="flex:1;background:#e8f7ee;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 2px;"><div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#1a7f37;">'+cnt("a")+'<span style="font-size:11px;color:#555;">/'+n+'</span></div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#555;">🎓 الحضور</div></div>'
+'<div style="flex:1;background:#e8f0fd;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 2px;"><div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#1d5fbf;">'+cnt("h")+'<span style="font-size:11px;color:#555;">/'+n+'</span></div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#555;">📓 الواجب</div></div>'
+'<div style="flex:1;background:#fdf3e8;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 2px;"><div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#c07800;">'+cntEx()+'<span style="font-size:11px;color:#555;">/'+n+'</span></div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#555;">📝 الامتحانات</div></div>'
+'<div style="flex:1;background:#f9f0ff;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 2px;"><div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:#8a3ecf;">'+avg+'</div><div style="font-size:10px;color:#555;">⭐ المستوى</div></div></div>'
+'<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;">'
+'<tr style="background:#f3dede;color:#7a1010;"><th style="padding:9px 6px;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #999;">🗓 الحصة والموعد</th><th style="padding:9px 6px;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #999;">🎓 الحضور</th><th style="padding:9px 6px;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #999;">📓 الواجب</th><th style="padding:9px 6px;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #999;">📝 الامتحان</th><th style="padding:9px 6px;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #999;">⭐ المستوى</th></tr>'
+(rows||'<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ddd;">لسه مفيش متابعة مسجلة</td></tr>')+tot+'</table>'+exHtml
+'<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:32px;">'
+'<div style="flex:1;border:1.5px solid #999;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#444;">توقيع ولي الأمر<br><br><br><span style="color:#aaa;">..............................</span></div>'
+'<div style="flex:1;border:1.5px solid #999;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#444;">ختم وتوقيع المدرسة<br><br><br><span style="color:#aaa;">..............................</span></div></div>'
